explication: Isaac Sim is a robotics simulation platform for developing, testing, training, and deploying robots in realistic virtual environments. The principal workflow is to bring robot or environment assets into the simulator, configure and simulate robot dynamics, use sensors and rendering to observe the scene, then use integrations such as ROS or synthetic-data generation in downstream workflows. The README documents these capabilities, while the supplied source excerpts cover only selected implementation areas; links between unsampled subsystems therefore reflect documented product relationships, not inspected call chains.
